## Verification

- [ ] The regression fails before the fix and passes after it.
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run check:examples`
- [ ] `npm run check:package` for packaging, public API or transport changes.
- [ ] No secrets, private page data, hidden model fallbacks or automatic mutation retries.
- [ ] CLI/MCP changes use the shared core and schemas.
